 This $100 Google Play gift card is down to $92 right now
 Android Police Follow Timi Cantisano Sat, November 14, 2026 at 3:05 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Sat, November 14, 2026 at 3:05 PM UTC The holidays are coming, which means there's a pretty good chance you might have to pick up a gift for someone. We've seen promotions on phones, smartwatches, TVs, audio gear, and more over the past few weeks, as Black Friday comes closer. But this is the first time we've seen a meaningful drop on a Google Play Gift Card, which is perfect for an Android user.
 How do I score this promotion?
 Lucas Gouveia / Android Police
 You can snag this $100 Google Play Gift Card from Newegg for $8 less, thanks to a special discount code that drops the price down during check out. You purchase a $100 Google Play Gift Card and then use code " BNWF2653 " which will save you $8 on your purchase, dropping the price down to just $92.
 Again, apply the code during checkout and you should see the savings. This promotion is not available for any other gift card denomination. You need to purchase the $100 gift card in order to save. So, if you want additional savings, you'll have to purchase more than one card.
 Advertisement Advertisement We think it's well worth it, especially if you live on the Google Play Store. Not only can you use this for apps and games, but you can also apply the credit towards any subscriptions that you might have. The great thing about a Google Play Gift Card is that you can use it for a number of things .
 It's versatile
 As mentioned before, a Google Play Gift Card isn't just for app purchases, since it can be used to buy pretty much anything digital from the Google Play Store .
 A Google Play Gift Card can also be used to pay for any subscriptions that are available from the store. That means you can put the $100 towards a Spotify subscription, pay for Netflix, YouTube Premium, and more.
 It can also be used for in-app purchases, in-game purchases, along with battle passes and game expansions. You can also purchase books, and media like movies and TV shows.
 Advertisement Advertisement As you can tell, it's quite versatile, making it a great gift for anyone or even yourself. The only thing that you can't use the Google Play Gift Card for is to buy physical goods. So, whatever you're looking to purchase, it's going to have to be digital.
 We like this deal a lot because you're just getting $100 of Google Play credit for just $92. This deal won't last long, so you'll want to pick it up as soon as possible.
